title: Epic: Anti-griefing spec hardening
description:
Griefing audit found gaps in resource exhaustion defenses. Strong authentication gates exist but several tables lack normative bounds and rate limits use SHOULD not MUST.

P1 (6): join-tracking table, gradient table, neighbor table, trust store bounds; SHOULD→MUST for join rate limits
P2 (10): fragment context bounds, claim rate limits, DIO/DAO rate limits, CoAP observer limits
P3 (4): EDHOC/OSCORE limits, table reservations

See child beads for individual fixes.
